capability_notes:
Taken verbatim from Atlas's own production-capabilities page (https://www.atlascontainer.com/corrugated-box-manufacturer/production-capabilities):

*** THE 75-INCH BLANK — THIS IS THE BUYER'S REAL ISSUE ***
Whether Atlas can do this depends entirely on ORIENTATION, and the answer may be NO:
- If 75" is the blank's WIDTH (cross-direction, across the machine) on a DIE-CUT part: NOT POSSIBLE. Their die cutters are two 66" Rotary Die Cutters (66" x 110"). 75" exceeds the 66" feed width. The Latitude FFG is 50" x 118" and the EMBA 245 maxes at 41" wide. Nothing they own die-cuts 75" wide.
- If 75" is the LENGTH (machine direction): FEASIBLE on the 66" rotary die cutters (110" long), the Latitude FFG (118"), the EMBA 245 (max blank 41" x 94"), and exactly at the limit on the EMBA 215 (max blank 29" x 75").
- For PLAIN slit/scored sheets (no die cutting): the corrugator is a 98" Fosber and the slitter takes max 120" sheet width, so 75" wide is fine.
Bottom line: a 75"-wide die-cut blank is almost certainly beyond this plant; a 75"-long blank is comfortably within it. Confirm before quoting.

- Corrugator: 2016 98" B-C-E flute Fosber single-facer; Min blank 10" x 24"; "Sheet Minimum 1,500 SF"
- EMBA 215 QS Ultima 3/C FFG: max blank 29" x 75"; box W/L 3-7/8" to 33-7/16"; depth min 2"; 3-color; 420 sheets/min
